description: Directory of all FDIC-insured banks with identity + headline figures. (Source: FFIEC + FDIC.) Dollar amounts are in thousands of US dollars ($000s); ratios are percentages.

q.description: Name search, case-insensitive. Alone, it uses the site's name matcher, which forgives punctuation, spacing and common abbreviations; with state or tier it matches any part of the legal name.

sort.description: Sort order: total_assets (default), legal_name, hq_state, established, cet1_ratio, roa, npl_ratio.
